description: List work items in the AnyForge backlog with status, priority, and any linked crew state. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 200 max), newest first: the result carries `total` (matches for THESE filters across every page), `hasMore`, `nextCursor`, `appliedFilters` (the filters that actually ran — check it when `total` surprises you) and `nextAction`. When `hasMore` is true, pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the SAME filters for the next page. A page with no relevant rows says nothing about the remaining pages — check `hasMore` before concluding there is no match. Narrow with `programId`, `initiativeId`, `team`, `status`, `priority`, `type`, `assignee`, `reporter`, `label` or `search` rather than paging through a whole backlog; `label` matches one exact label, such as a stage of a label group (anyforge_list_label_groups lists the groups and anyforge_list_work_boards the boards that follow them); to scope a question first, resolve the initiative with anyforge_list_initiatives, then list its items with `initiativeId`. `search` matches id, code, title, description, acceptance criteria, design notes, crew id, latest-status text, tags, component ids and the tracker key (`externalRef.key` or `jiraIssueKey`) — not lifecycle status or initiative names. By default archived items are excluded. Each item carries `assigneeName`, `blockerOwnerName` and `createdByName` beside `assigneeUid`, `blockerOwnerUid` and `createdBy`: the member's name (or email), null when the field is empty or names someone who is not an approved member.

assignee.description: Filter by human assignee uid; use 'me' for the API key owner.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with identical filters.

itemId.description: Filter to an exact work-item id or queue code.

label.description: Only items carrying this exact label (case-insensitive), for example one stage of a label group. A label group's name is not a label: list the groups with anyforge_list_label_groups.

owner.description: Filter by owner uid; use 'me' for the API key owner.

priority.description: Filter by priority; `none` lists items with no priority.

reporter.description: Filter by who reported (filed) the item, by uid; use 'me' for the API key owner.

search.description: Search by work-item id, code, title, description, crew id or tracker key (case-insensitive substring).

team.description: Filter to a team's items by team slug, including every team beneath it. An item's team is the one set on it, else its initiative's. An unknown slug is refused (unknown_team).

name: anyforge_list_work_items
title: List work items
